item.title: CN Blue to perform at Kspo Dome in February
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
CNBlue will celebrate its debut at Kspo Dome in Seoul, one of the most coveted concert venues in Korea, according to agency FNC Entertainment on Monday. The three-member band set fans abuzz with the news that it is holding a live show at the dome next year, before concluding an encore concert in Busan on Sunday. item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
The Boyz will conduct their group activities under the newly established agency 78 Records, according to the company on Monday. The agency was reportedly co-founded by people who have worked closely with the group since before their debut and through their major turning points — including their win on the competition show “Road to Kingdom.” In August, The Boyz members inked a deal to continue as a group of nine. item.title: Seungri denies assault allegation: 'I did not swing the bottle'
item.description:
Korea Herald • Legal / dispute
Former Big Bang member Seungri has denied an aggravated assault allegation after a man in his 30s filed a criminal complaint against him. He acknowledged that he held a liquor bottle during a dispute but insists he neither swung it nor threatened the man. According to local media reports Thursday, police received the complaint on Aug. 26, accusing Seungri of aggravated assault, and are looking into the circumstances surrounding the alleged incident. item.description:

Four solo tracks Aespa unveiled at the girl group's Seoul concert in August will be published as a special digital single set, SM Entertainment said Friday. item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Hwasa is poised to hit the stage at Rock in Rio, a first for a female artist from Korea, her agency P Nation said Friday. She will mark her debut on the main stage, Palco Mundo, World Stage, in Rio de Janeiro the same day. item.description:
Korea Herald • Legal / dispute

The management company added that it has been monitoring and taking legal action against infringements of its artists' interests. item.description:

&Team's story began in Japan, not Korea. Launched there in 2022 as Hybe’s first localized global act, the group was built with a distinctly Japanese base. item.title: Lightsum to drop prerelease from Japan debut album
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Girl group Lightsum will unveil the main track from its Japan debut album in advance, its agency Cube Entertainment said Wednesday. The six-member group will release the EP “Re:idol” on Sept. 23 and drop the single “Doshite” on Sept. 16. The prerelease portrays the ups and downs of having a crush, mixing in cute dance moves. item.title: Evan tops iTunes chart in 11 regions with 1st solo EP
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Evan, formerly of Enhypen, topped the iTunes Top Albums Chart in 11 regions with his first solo EP “Death of Me,” according to agency Belift Lab on Wednesday. The title track claimed the No. 1 spot on the iTunes Top Songs Chart in nine regions. He released the mini album on Monday, and the title track debuted atop the real-time songs chart on Bugs and entered Melon’s Hot 100 at No. 5.
